<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Gerenciador KM — Kingmaker (PF2e)</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Rye&family=Alegreya+Sans+SC:wght@500;700;800&family=Alegreya:ital,wght@0,500;0,700;1,500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --ink:#26200f;
  --paper:#e9dcae;
  --parchment:#f2e8c9;
  --panel:rgba(250,244,224,.62);
  --boxbg:#fbf7e6;
  --cream:#faf5e4;
  --forest:#4b5a22;
  --forest-dd:#2c3610;
  --forest-l:#7c8f3f;
  --line:#8a9a4b;
  --gold:#c9a227;
  --gold-l:#e2c265;
  --rust:#9c3f28;
  --rust-l:#c96a52;
  --f-title:'Rye',serif;
  --f-label:'Alegreya Sans SC',sans-serif;
  --f-body:'Alegreya',Georgia,serif;
  --tap:44px;
  /* Variantes "seguras para texto": mesma família cromática de --forest-l/--rust-l,
     escurecidas ao mínimo necessário para atingir 4.5:1 de contraste com texto branco
     (WCAG AA). Usadas apenas onde texto branco fica em cima da cor; bordas e outros
     usos decorativos de --forest-l/--rust-l permanecem inalterados. */
  --forest-l-txt:#6b7c37;
  --rust-l-txt:#be563b;
  --bottomnav-h:60px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html,body{height:100%}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
  font-family:var(--f-body);color:var(--ink);background-color:var(--paper);
  font-size:16px;line-height:1.4;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% -10%, rgba(255,252,235,.75), transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 110%, rgba(140,100,30,.25), transparent 55%),
    url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='240' height='240'><filter id='n'><feTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.8' numOctaves='2' stitchTiles='stitch'/><feColorMatrix type='saturate' values='0'/><feComponentTransfer><feFuncA type='table' tableValues='0 0.07'/></feComponentTransfer></filter><rect width='240' height='240' filter='url(%23n)'/></svg>");
}
body::before{content:'';position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:2;box-shadow:inset 0 0 140px rgba(90,60,10,.32)}
.honey{position:fixed;right:0;top:0;height:100%;width:170px;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:.9;
  -webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to left,#000 55%,transparent);mask-image:linear-gradient(to left,#000 55%,transparent)}
a{color:inherit}
::selection{background:var(--gold-l)}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:2px}

/* ===== SHELL / NAVEGAÇÃO ===== */
#app{display:flex;min-height:100vh;min-height:100dvh;position:relative;z-index:1}
#sidebar{
  width:214px;flex:0 0 214px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;position:sticky;top:0;
  height:100vh;height:100dvh;overflow-y:auto;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#5a6a26,#3c481a 65%,#2f3814);border-right:3px solid var(--forest-dd);
  padding:16px 11px calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
}
.side-title{
  font-family:var(--f-title);color:var(--cream);text-align:center;font-size:18px;
  text-shadow:1px 2px 0 var(--forest-dd);padding:4px 0 13px;
  border-bottom:2px solid rgba(246,239,212,.32);margin-bottom:8px;letter-spacing:.5px;
}
.nav-btn{
  font-family:var(--f-label);font-weight:800;font-size:13.5px;letter-spacing:.4px;cursor:pointer;
  background:var(--cream);color:var(--forest);border:2px solid var(--forest-dd);border-radius:8px;
  padding:10px 12px;text-align:left;transition:transform .15s,background .15s;box-shadow:0 2px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;min-height:var(--tap);flex:0 0 auto;position:relative;
}
.nav-btn .ico{font-size:15px;line-height:1;flex:0 0 auto}
.nav-btn .lbl{white-space:normal}
.nav-btn:hover{transform:translateX(3px)}
.nav-btn.active{background:var(--forest-l-txt);color:#fff;text-shadow:1px 1px 0 var(--forest-dd);transform:translateX(5px)}
.nav-btn.active::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;right:8px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:9px;height:9px;
  border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.5) inset,0 0 5px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
}
.side-footer{margin-top:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;padding-top:10px}
.side-footer button{
  font-family:var(--f-label);font-weight:700;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;background:rgba(246,239,212,.14);
  color:var(--cream);border:1.5px solid rgba(246,239,212,.45);border-radius:6px;padding:9px 6px;min-height:38px;
}
.side-footer button:hover{background:rgba(246,239,212,.28)}
.side-note{font:700 9.5px var(--f-label);color:rgba(246,239,212,.65);text-align:center;margin-top:4px;letter-spacing:.4px}

/* ===== NAVEGAÇÃO MOBILE: barra de abas inferior + folha "Mais" =====
   Oculta por padrão (display:none); só aparece em @media(max-width:820px),
   no bloco RESPONSIVO abaixo, exatamente quando o #sidebar de coluna some.
   Reaproveita a paleta e os tokens já existentes — nenhum estilo novo de cor. */
#bottomNav{
  display:none;position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:45;height:var(--bottomnav-h);
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#3c481a,#2f3814);border-top:3px solid var(--forest-dd);
  padding:4px max(4px,env(safe-area-inset-right)) env(safe-area-inset-bottom) max(4px,env(safe-area-inset-left));
  box-shadow:0 -3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
}
.bn-btn{
  flex:1 1 0;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:2px;
  background:none;border:none;color:var(--cream);cursor:pointer;padding:4px 2px;border-radius:8px;min-height:var(--tap);
}
.bn-btn .ico{font-size:18px;line-height:1}
.bn-btn .lbl{font:800 9.5px var(--f-label);letter-spacing:.2px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;max-width:100%}
.bn-btn.active{background:rgba(246,239,212,.16);color:#fff}
.bn-btn.active .ico{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,.5))}
.mais-mods{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;margin:14px 0 4px}
.mais-mods .nav-btn{width:100%}
/* .side-footer (Exportar/Importar/Restaurar + aviso de salvamento) foi estilizado
   para o fundo verde-escuro do #sidebar. Realocado para dentro da folha "Mais"
   (fundo claro do modal), precisa da paleta invertida para continuar legível —
   mesmo conteúdo e mesmos botões, apenas cores adequadas ao novo fundo. */
#maisFooterSlot{border-top:2px dashed var(--line);margin-top:6px;padding-top:12px}
#maisFooterSlot .side-footer{margin:0;padding:0}
#maisFooterSlot .side-footer button{background:var(--boxbg);color:var(--forest-dd);border:1.5px solid var(--forest-l)}
#maisFooterSlot .side-footer button:hover{background:#fffbe9;border-color:var(--forest)}
#maisFooterSlot .side-note{color:var(--forest);display:block;margin-top:8px}

#main{flex:1;padding:24px 28px 60px;overflow-x:hidden;min-width:0}
.module{display:none}
.module.active{display:block;animation:fade .22s ease}
@keyframes fade{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

/* ===== BUSCA & ALERTAS ===== */
.search-input{
  width:100%;max-width:320px;background:var(--boxbg);border:2px solid var(--forest-l);border-radius:20px;
  padding:9px 16px;font:600 14.5px var(--f-body);color:var(--ink);outline:none;margin-bottom:18px;
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 3px rgba(90,70,20,.15);
}
.search-input:focus{border-color:var(--forest);background:#fffbe9}
@keyframes pulseAlert { 0% { border-color: var(--rust); box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--rust); } 50% { border-color: var(--rust-l); box-shadow: 0 0 2px var(--rust); } 100% { border-color: var(--rust); box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--rust); } }
.alert-danger { animation: pulseAlert 1.2s infinite !important; background-color: rgba(156,63,40,0.12) !important; color:var(--rust) !important; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
  .module.active{animation:none}
  .alert-danger{animation:none !important}
  .nav-btn,.nav-btn.active,.bn-btn{transition:none;transform:none !important}
  *{scroll-behavior:auto}
}

/* ===== BANNERS & INPUTS ===== */
.banner{
  position:relative;font-family:var(--f-title);font-size:15px;letter-spacing:1px;color:#fff;text-align:center;
  background:linear-gradient(#7f9040,#5a6b28);border:2px solid var(--forest-dd);border-radius:10px;padding:7px 28px;
  text-shadow:1px 2px 0 var(--forest-dd);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.15),0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
  width:max-content;max-width:100%;margin:4px auto;
}
.banner::before{content:'☙';position:absolute;left:7px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-54%);color:#dfe6bd;font-size:15px;text-shadow:none}
.banner::after{content:'❧';position:absolute;right:7px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-54%);color:#dfe6bd;font-size:15px;text-shadow:none}
.banner.small{font-size:12.5px;padding:5px 24px}
.banner.big{font-size:19px;margin:0}

.line-input{border:none;border-bottom:2px solid var(--line);background:transparent;font:700 15px var(--f-label);color:var(--ink);padding:5px 5px;outline:none;width:100%;min-height:var(--tap)}
.line-input:focus{border-bottom-color:var(--forest);background:rgba(138,154,75,.12)}
.line-input:disabled{opacity:.75;background:transparent;border-bottom-style:dashed;color:var(--forest)}
select.line-input{border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;background:var(--boxbg);font:700 13px var(--f-label);padding:5px 8px;-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;background-image:linear-gradient(45deg,transparent 50%,var(--forest) 50%),linear-gradient(135deg,var(--forest) 50%,transparent 50%);background-position:calc(100% - 16px) center,calc(100% - 11px) center;background-size:5px 5px,5px 5px;background-repeat:no-repeat}
.box-input{background:var(--boxbg);border:2px solid var(--forest-l);border-radius:6px;text-align:center;font:800 16px var(--f-label);color:var(--ink);outline:none;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 3px rgba(90,70,20,.2);min-height:var(--tap)}
.box-input:focus{border-color:var(--forest);background:#fffbe9}
.box-input:disabled{background:rgba(0,0,0,0.04); color:var(--rust); border-style:dashed;}
.box-input.sm{width:56px;height:46px}
.tiny{font:800 10px var(--f-label);color:var(--forest);letter-spacing:.5px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;justify-content:center}
.tiny-input{border:none;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--line);background:transparent;width:44px;font:700 12px var(--f-label);text-align:center;outline:none;color:var(--ink)}
.label-sc{font:800 12px var(--f-label);color:var(--forest);letter-spacing:.6px;text-transform:uppercase}
.label-sc.compact{font-size:9.5px} /* substitui 10 ocorrências de style="font-size:9.5px" repetidas (Locais de Trabalho, Materiais da Ficha de Local) */
/* Utilitárias — parte da limpeza de estilos inline: substituem os padrões
   repetidos mais seguros de converter (valor único, sem dependência de
   contexto). Os estilos inline restantes (larguras específicas de modal,
   ajustes pontuais de um único elemento) foram deixados como estavam — não
   têm repetição, então uma classe não traria ganho de manutenção. */
.clickable{cursor:pointer}
.m0{margin:0}
.label-sc.link{cursor:pointer;text-decoration:underline dotted;text-underline-offset:3px}
.label-sc.link:hover{color:var(--forest-l)}
.link{cursor:pointer;text-decoration:underline dotted;text-underline-offset:3px}
.link:hover{color:var(--forest-l)}

.sheet{max-width:1150px;margin:0 auto;background:var(--panel);border-radius:12px;padding:26px 30px;
  box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(60,40,0,.18),inset 0 0 70px rgba(120,90,20,.1)}
.sheet-top{display:flex;gap:20px;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:20px}
.kingdom-name{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:14px;flex:1;min-width:280px}
.kingdom-name .big{font-family:var(--f-title);font-size:23px;color:var(--forest-dd);text-shadow:1px 1px 0 var(--cream),2px 3px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.2);white-space:nowrap}
.kingdom-name .line-input{font-size:17px}
.top-boxes{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.tbox{background:var(--boxbg);border:2px solid var(--forest-dd);border-radius:12px 12px 6px 6px;padding:8px 12px;min-width:110px}
.tbox .tbox-main{width:70px;height:38px;font-size:20px;margin:4px auto 2px;display:block}
.nivel-tag{background:linear-gradient(#7f9040,#5a6b28);color:#fff;font-family:var(--f-title);font-size:12px;text-align:center;border-radius:5px;padding:3px 8px;text-shadow:1px 1px 0 var(--forest-dd);margin-top:4px}
.tbox label{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;font:800 12px var(--f-label);color:var(--forest);margin:5px 0}
.tbox label input{width:56px}
.sheet-cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:46fr 54fr;gap:30px}
@media(max-width:940px){.sheet-cols{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* Chips de âncora rápida — só em celular (a ficha em coluna dupla do desktop
   já não sofre tanto com rolagem). Links <a href="#sec-x"> puros: funcionam
   mesmo sem JS, e html{scroll-behavior:smooth} (abaixo) faz a rolagem suave. */
.anchor-chip-bar{display:none}
.anchor-chip{font:800 11.5px var(--f-label);background:var(--boxbg);color:var(--forest-dd);border:2px solid var(--forest-l);
  border-radius:14px;padding:6px 12px;white-space:nowrap;text-decoration:none;flex:0 0 auto;min-height:34px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center}
.anchor-chip:hover{background:#fffbe9;border-color:var(--forest)}
[id^="sec-"]{scroll-margin-top:14px}

/* Seções retráteis da Ficha do Reino (Atributos+CD, Materiais, Locais de
   Trabalho) — mesmo padrão nativo <details> já usado em Tabelas & Mecânicas.
   Ruína e Acordos Comerciais permanecem sempre visíveis (não viraram
   <details>) porque o banner deles já tem uma ação de clique própria — abrir
   a regra em um modal — e transformar o mesmo clique em "abrir regra +
   recolher a seção" seria ambíguo; ambos continuam alcançáveis pelos chips
   de âncora acima. */
.section-details>summary{cursor:pointer;list-style:none}
.section-details>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.disc-ico{display:inline-block;transition:transform .15s;margin-left:2px;font-size:.85em}
.section-details:not([open])>summary .disc-ico{transform:rotate(-90deg)}

/* ===== FICHA BASE REINO ===== */
.att-head{display:flex;gap:8px;font:800 10.5px var(--f-label);color:var(--forest);letter-spacing:.5px;margin:6px 2px}
.att-head span:first-child{width:56px;text-align:center}
.att-row{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:9px}
.att-label{flex:1;background:linear-gradient(#8a9a45,#4b5a22);border:2px solid var(--forest-dd);border-radius:7px;color:#fff;
  font-family:var(--f-title);font-size:13.5px;text-align:center;padding:10px 6px;text-shadow:1px 1px 0 var(--forest-dd);letter-spacing:.5px;min-height:var(--tap);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.ruin-head,.ruin-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 64px 64px 64px 138px;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.ruin-head{margin:6px 2px;font:800 10.5px var(--f-label);color:var(--forest);letter-spacing:.5px}
.ruin-head span{text-align:center}
.ruin-row{margin-bottom:9px}
.ruin-row .att-label{font-size:12.5px}
.ruin-row input{width:100%;height:44px}
.ru-disp{width:100%;height:44px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:15px;background:rgba(138,154,75,.15);border-style:dashed}
.ru-reswrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;min-width:138px}
.ru-reslabel{display:none;font:800 9px var(--f-label);color:var(--forest);margin-right:6px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.4px}
.rk-box{width:18px;height:18px;border:2px solid var(--forest-l);border-radius:3px;background:var(--boxbg);cursor:pointer;display:inline-block;margin-left:4px;padding:0;outline-offset:2px;}
.rk-box.on{background:var(--forest-l);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
.ru-ressum{font:800 11px var(--f-label);color:var(--forest);margin-left:6px}
.rule{border:none;border-top:3px double var(--forest-l);margin:16px 0}
.cd-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;justify-content:center;margin:12px 0 4px}
.cd-total{width:68px;height:54px;font-size:22px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.cd-break{font:700 11.5px var(--f-label);color:var(--forest);text-align:center;margin:2px 0 8px;letter-spacing:.3px}
.mat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:9px;margin-top:10px}
.mat-grid.six{grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr)}
.mat{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;align-items:center}
.mat .box-input{width:100%;height:50px}
.mat-sub{font:700 8.5px var(--f-label);color:#6b6248;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.4px;text-align:center;line-height:1.2}
.mat-max{font:800 9px var(--f-label);color:var(--forest);text-align:center;line-height:1.3}
.mat-max b{font-size:11px}
.field{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;margin-bottom:11px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.field .label-sc{white-space:nowrap;font-size:13px}
.stats-row{display:flex;gap:9px;margin:14px 0 6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.stat{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;flex:1;min-width:74px}
.stat .label-sc{font-size:9.5px;text-align:center}
.stat .box-input{width:100%;height:54px}
.stat-note{font:700 10px var(--f-label);color:#6b6248;text-align:center;margin:0 0 12px;font-style:italic}
.leader-note{font:800 10.5px var(--f-label);color:var(--forest);text-align:center;margin:2px 0 10px;letter-spacing:.4px}
.leader-row{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);border-radius:8px;padding:8px}
.chk{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;cursor:pointer;margin-top:2px;min-height:28px}
.chk input{display:none}
.chkbox{width:22px;height:22px;background:var(--boxbg);border:2px solid var(--forest-l);border-radius:5px;display:inline-block;position:relative;flex:0 0 auto}
.chk input:checked + .chkbox{background:var(--forest-l)}
.chk input:checked + .chkbox::after{content:'✓';position:absolute;inset:0;color:#fff;font:800 15px/18px var(--f-label);text-align:center}
.chk-label{font:800 9px var(--f-label);color:var(--forest)}
.leader-main{flex:1;min-width:0}
.leader-role{font-family:var(--f-title);font-size:14px;color:var(--forest-dd);letter-spacing:.5px;text-shadow:1px 1px 0 var(--cream)}
.leader-char{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.leader-char .label-sc{font-size:9.5px}
.leader-pick-btn{flex:1;min-width:140px;text-align:left;background:var(--boxbg);border:2px solid var(--forest-l);border-radius:6px;padding:9px 12px;font:700 13.5px var(--f-body);color:var(--forest-dd);cursor:pointer;min-height:var(--tap)}
.leader-pick-btn:hover{background:#fffbe9;border-color:var(--forest)}
.leader-pick-btn.empty{color:#767059;font-style:italic;font-weight:600} /* era #8a8368 (3.53:1) — ajustado para 4.5:1 (WCAG AA) */
.picker-group-title{font:800 10.5px var(--f-label);letter-spacing:.4px;color:var(--forest);margin:10px 0 2px;padding-top:6px;border-top:1px dashed var(--line)}
.picker-group-title:first-child{margin-top:0;padding-top:0;border-top:none}
.quick-add-row{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px}
.quick-add-row input,.quick-add-row select{min-height:40px}
.work-block{min-width:0}
.work-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:9px;margin-top:10px}
.work-grid .mat .box-input{height:48px}
.work-note{font:italic 500 11.5px var(--f-body);color:#524a34;margin-top:9px;text-align:justify}

/* PERÍCIAS */
.sk-wrap{overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:8px;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.sk-min{min-width:1090px}
.sk-head,.sk-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:150px 56px 16px 96px 50px 122px repeat(5,minmax(54px,1fr));gap:6px;align-items:center}
.sk-head{margin:14px 0 8px}
.sk-head span{font:800 9.5px var(--f-label);color:var(--forest);text-align:center;letter-spacing:.4px}
.sk-row{margin-bottom:8px}
.sk-name{font:800 14.5px var(--f-label);color:var(--forest-dd);letter-spacing:.3px}
.sk-total,.sk-prof{height:42px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:15px}
.eq-sm{font:800 15px var(--f-label);color:var(--forest);text-align:center}
.attr-tag{height:36px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:linear-gradient(#8a9a45,#4b5a22);
  color:#fff;font:800 9px var(--f-label);border:1.5px solid var(--forest-dd);border-radius:4px;letter-spacing:.3px;text-shadow:1px 1px 0 var(--forest-dd)}
.ranks{display:flex;gap:4px;justify-content:center}
.rank{width:28px;height:32px;background:var(--boxbg);border:2px solid var(--forest-l);border-radius:5px;font:800 12px var(--f-label);color:var(--forest);cursor:pointer;padding:0;outline-offset:2px;}
.rank.on{background:var(--forest-l-txt);color:#fff;text-shadow:1px 1px 0 var(--forest-dd)}
.sk-num{width:100%;height:42px;font-size:14px}
.sk-pen{width:100%;height:42px;font-size:14px;text-align:center;background:rgba(156,63,40,.10);border-color:var(--rust);color:var(--rust);font-weight:800}
.talhab{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:36px;margin-top:28px}
@media(max-width:900px){.talhab{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.lv-row{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-bottom:7px}
.lv-num{font:800 13px var(--f-label);color:var(--forest);width:24px;padding-top:5px}
.lv-lines{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px}
.entry-line{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--line);min-height:30px;padding:4px 6px}
.entry-line .txt{flex:1;font:700 14px var(--f-body);color:var(--ink)}
.mini-act{display:flex;gap:4px}
.mini-act button{border:none;background:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:15px;color:var(--forest);min-width:30px;min-height:30px}
.mini-act button:hover{color:var(--rust)}
.btn-add{font:800 14px var(--f-label);letter-spacing:.5px;cursor:pointer;color:#fff;text-shadow:1px 1px 0 var(--forest-dd);
  background:linear-gradient(#7f9040,#4c5b23);border:2px solid var(--forest-dd);border-radius:9px;padding:10px 18px;box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.3);transition:.15s;min-height:var(--tap)}
.btn-add:hover{filter:brightness(1.1);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.btn-add.small{font-size:12px;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:7px;min-height:38px}

/* WIZARD DE TURNO E HISTÓRICO */
.wizard-box{background:var(--boxbg);border:2px solid var(--forest-l);border-radius:10px;padding:20px;margin-bottom:20px;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(60,40,0,.15)}
.wizard-title{font-family:var(--f-title);font-size:17px;color:var(--forest-dd);margin-bottom:12px;border-bottom:2px dashed var(--line);padding-bottom:6px}
.wizard-step{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.3);padding:10px 12px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid rgba(138,154,75,.3)}
.wizard-step .chkbox{margin-top:2px}
.log-area{width:100%;height:100px;background:#fffbe9;border:2px solid var(--forest-l);border-radius:6px;padding:10px;font:600 14px var(--f-body);color:var(--ink);resize:vertical;outline:none}
.log-area:focus{border-color:var(--forest)}
.log-area.locked{background:rgba(0,0,0,.05);color:var(--forest-dd);cursor:not-allowed}
.history-item{background:rgba(250,244,224,.8);border-left:4px solid var(--forest-l);padding:12px 14px;margin-bottom:10px;border-radius:0 6px 6px 0;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.1);
  content-visibility:auto;contain-intrinsic-size:auto 140px} /* campanhas longas acumulam muitos registros de turno; navegadores compatíveis pulam layout/paint dos itens fora da tela — ignorado sem efeito em navegadores sem suporte */
.hist-turn{font:800 12px var(--f-label);color:var(--forest);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;margin-bottom:4px}
.hist-text{font-size:14px;color:var(--ink);white-space:pre-wrap}
.hist-head{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;}
.hist-acoes{background:rgba(76,90,32,.08);border:1px dashed var(--forest-l);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 10px;margin:8px 0}
.hist-acoes .label-sc{font-size:10px}
.hist-acoes ul{margin:5px 0 0;padding-left:18px}
.hist-acoes li{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--forest-dd);margin-bottom:2px}

/* Estilos para o Checklist do Reino */
.checklist-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)); gap: 15px; margin-top: 10px; }
.checklist-phase { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04); padding: 12px; border-left: 4px solid var(--rust); border-radius: 4px; }
.checklist-phase>summary.phase-summary { margin: 0 0 10px 0; color: var(--forest); font-family: 'Alegreya Sans SC', sans-serif; font-size: 1.1em; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1); padding-bottom: 5px;
  cursor:pointer; list-style:none; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:8px; }
.checklist-phase>summary.phase-summary::-webkit-details-marker { display:none; }
.checklist-phase>summary.phase-summary::before { content:'▾'; font-size:.85em; order:-1; margin-right:6px; transition:transform .15s; }
.checklist-phase:not([open])>summary.phase-summary::before { transform:rotate(-90deg); }
.checklist-phase:not([open])>summary.phase-summary { margin-bottom:0; border-bottom-color:transparent; }
.phase-progress { font: 800 10.5px var(--f-label); color: var(--forest-dd); background: rgba(255,255,255,.5); border: 1.5px solid var(--forest-l); border-radius: 12px; padding: 2px 9px; letter-spacing: .3px; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.checklist-phase[data-complete="1"] .phase-progress { background: var(--forest-l-txt); color: #fff; border-color: var(--forest-dd); }
.checklist-phase label { display: block; font-size: 0.9em; margin-bottom: 6px; cursor: pointer; line-height: 1.3; }
.checklist-phase input[type="checkbox"] { margin-right: 6px; accent-color: var(--rust); transform: translateY(2px); }
.turn-step-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 6px; }
.turn-step-row label { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.step-info-btn { flex: 0 0 auto; width: 20px; height: 20px; margin-top: 1px; padding: 0; border: 1.5px solid var(--forest-l); border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255,255,255,.6); color: var(--forest-dd); font: 700 11px var(--f-body); line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.step-info-btn:hover, .step-info-btn:focus-visible { background: var(--forest-l); color: #fff; }

/* Novos estilos para as opções e sub-etapas do checklist */
.phase-opts { list-style-type: none; padding-left: 26px; margin-bottom: 10px; margin-top: -2px; }
.phase-opts li { font-size: 0.85em; color: var(--forest-dd); position: relative; margin-bottom: 3px; line-height: 1.2; }
.phase-opts li::before { content: '▪'; position: absolute; left: -14px; color: var(--rust-l); }
.atividade-nota-item { cursor: pointer; }
.atividade-nota-item:hover, .atividade-nota-item:focus-visible { color: var(--rust); text-decoration: underline; outline: none; }
.atividade-nota-item.tem-nota::after { content: ' 📝'; }
.atividade-nota-item.nota-trancada::after { content: ' 🔒'; }
.phase-details { margin-left: 26px; margin-bottom: 10px; margin-top: -4px; }
.phase-details summary { cursor: pointer; color: var(--forest); font-size: 0.85em; font-weight: 700; outline: none; }
.phase-details summary:hover { color: var(--rust); }
.phase-details .phase-opts { margin-top: 6px; margin-left: 0; padding-left: 14px; border-left: 1px solid rgba(138,154,75,.3); }

/* CRUD / FICHAS PADRÃO (CARDS) */
.mod-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;max-width:1150px;margin:0 auto 16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.card-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(270px,1fr));gap:16px;max-width:1150px;margin:0 auto}
.card{background:var(--boxbg);border:2px solid var(--forest-l);border-radius:10px;padding:14px 16px;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(60,40,0,.2);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px}
.card-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;border-bottom:2px solid rgba(138,154,75,.4);padding-bottom:7px;min-height:36px}
.card-tags{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end}
.badge-map{background:#2f7d8a}
.card-title{font-family:var(--f-title);font-size:15px;color:var(--forest-dd);word-wrap:break-word}
.badge{font:800 10.5px var(--f-label);background:var(--forest-l-txt);color:#fff;border-radius:20px;padding:3px 10px;letter-spacing:.5px;white-space:nowrap;text-shadow:1px 1px 0 var(--forest-dd)}
.card-row{font-size:14px;display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.card-l{font:800 11px var(--f-label);color:var(--forest);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.4px;padding-top:1px}
.card-v{font-weight:700}
.card-note{font-size:13.5px;font-style:italic;color:#524a34;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:3;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden;margin-top:4px;}
.card-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:auto;padding-top:12px}
.btn-mini{flex:1;font:800 11.5px var(--f-label);letter-spacing:.5px;cursor:pointer;border-radius:6px;padding:8px 6px;transition:.12s;min-height:40px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px}
.btn-edit{background:var(--forest-l-txt);border:1.5px solid var(--forest-dd);color:#fff;text-shadow:1px 1px 0 var(--forest-dd)}
.btn-del{background:var(--rust-l-txt);border:1.5px solid #6f2417;color:#fff;text-shadow:1px 1px 0 #6f2417}
.btn-mini:hover{filter:brightness(1.12)}
.empty{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;font-style:italic;color:#6b6248;padding:34px 20px;border:2px dashed var(--line);border-radius:10px}

/* ===== TIPOS DE VISUALIZAÇÃO: Cartões (padrão, sem classe extra) / Grade / Lista em Blocos / Pilha de Cartões =====
   Aplicadas ao mesmo #grid-<chave> via classes vm-*; os itens continuam filhos diretos do
   contentor em todos os modos, então a busca e o filtro de Eventos continuam funcionando. */
.btn-viewswitch{white-space:nowrap}

.card-grid.vm-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(190px,1fr));gap:10px}
.card-grid.vm-grid .card{padding:9px 11px;gap:4px}
.card-grid.vm-grid .card-title{font-size:12.5px}
.card-grid.vm-grid .card-row{font-size:12px}
.card-grid.vm-grid .card-note{font-size:11.5px;-webkit-line-clamp:2}
.card-grid.vm-grid .card-actions{gap:5px;padding-top:7px}
.card-grid.vm-grid .btn-mini{font-size:10px;padding:6px 4px;min-height:32px}

.card-grid.vm-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;max-width:900px}
.card-grid.vm-list .card{flex-direction:row;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:10px 16px}
.card-grid.vm-list .card-head{border-bottom:none;padding-bottom:0;min-height:0;min-width:170px;flex:0 0 auto}
.card-grid.vm-list .card-row{flex:1 1 160px}
.card-grid.vm-list .card-note{flex:1 1 220px;margin-top:0;-webkit-line-clamp:2}
.card-grid.vm-list .card-actions{margin-top:0;padding-top:0;flex:0 0 auto;width:auto}
.card-grid.vm-list .btn-mini{flex:0 0 auto;min-width:84px}

.card-grid.vm-stack{display:block;max-width:480px}
.card-grid.vm-stack .card{display:none}
.card-grid.vm-stack .card.stack-current{display:flex}
.card-grid.vm-stack .empty{grid-column:auto}

.stack-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:14px;max-width:480px;margin:14px auto 0}
.stack-nav[hidden]{display:none}
.stack-nav .stack-counter{font:800 12.5px var(--f-label);color:var(--forest-dd)}
.stack-nav .btn-mini{flex:0 0 auto;min-width:110px}

/* FORMULÁRIO INTERNO DA FICHA DE LOCAL */
.col-panel{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);border:1px solid rgba(138,154,75,.3);border-radius:8px;padding:16px;}
.ed-row{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:7px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.ed-row input{flex:1;min-width:110px;background:var(--boxbg);border:2px solid var(--forest-l);border-radius:6px;padding:9px 8px;font:600 13.5px var(--f-body);min-height:var(--tap)}
.ed-del{border:none;background:none;color:var(--rust);cursor:pointer;font-size:17px;min-width:36px;min-height:36px}
.ed-row-mapa{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:7px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;background:rgba(76,90,32,.08);border:1px dashed var(--forest-l);border-radius:6px;padding:6px 10px}
.ed-mapa-badge{font-size:14px;flex-shrink:0}
.ed-nome-ro{flex:1;min-width:110px;font:700 13.5px var(--f-body);color:var(--forest-dd)}
.ed-tipo-ro{font:600 12px var(--f-body);color:#6b6248;font-style:italic}
.ed-legend{font-size:11px;font-style:italic;color:#6b6248;margin:-4px 0 10px}
.sheet-ta{width:100%;background:var(--boxbg);border:2px solid var(--forest-l);border-radius:6px;padding:9px 10px;font:600 14px var(--f-body);color:var(--ink);outline:none;resize:vertical;min-height:70px}
.ficha-cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px}
@media(max-width:900px){.ficha-cols{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* ===== MÓDULO DE ESTRUTURAS ===== */
.est-filterbar{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;max-width:1150px;margin:0 auto 16px}
.est-filterbar select{background:var(--boxbg);border:2px solid var(--forest-l);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 10px;font:700 13px var(--f-body);color:var(--ink);min-height:42px}
.est-filterbar input.search-input{margin:0;flex:1;min-width:180px}
.cat-tag{display:inline-block;font:800 9.5px var(--f-label);color:#fff;border-radius:5px;padding:2px 7px;letter-spacing:.3px;white-space:nowrap;text-shadow:1px 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.cat-residencial{background:#966d3e}.cat-comercio{background:#8d721b}.cat-industria{background:#7c6a52}
.cat-defesa{background:#8a3220}.cat-conhecimento{background:#3d6fa5}.cat-religiao{background:#7a5fae}
.cat-governo{background:#5a6b28}.cat-lazer{background:#be563b}.cat-ilicito{background:#3c3c3c}
.cat-portuario{background:#2f7d8a}.cat-saude{background:#2c8458}.cat-outro{background:#767668}
.est-tbl td.efeito-cell{font-size:12.5px;font-style:italic;color:#524a34;max-width:280px}
.est-tbl td.nome-cell{font-family:var(--f-label);font-weight:800;color:var(--forest-dd)}
.tracos-mini{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:3px}
.traco-chip{font:700 8.5px var(--f-label);background:rgba(76,90,32,.15);color:var(--forest-dd);border-radius:4px;padding:1px 5px}
/* ===== MÓDULO HEXCRAWL (iframe do mapa) ===== */
.hexcrawl-frame-wrap{max-width:1150px;margin:0 auto;background:var(--panel);border-radius:12px;padding:10px;box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(60,40,0,.18);box-sizing:border-box}
.hexcrawl-frame{width:100%;height:78vh;min-height:520px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:#151515;display:block}
@media(max-width:700px){.hexcrawl-frame{height:70vh}}

.mapa-wrap{max-width:560px;margin:0 auto;background:var(--panel);border-radius:12px;padding:18px 14px;box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(60,40,0,.18);box-sizing:border-box}
.front-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,150px));gap:8px 14px;justify-content:center;margin:0 auto 16px;max-width:340px}
.front-item{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:3px;min-width:0}
.front-item span{font:800 9.5px var(--f-label);color:var(--forest-dd);letter-spacing:.3px}
.front-item select{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;font:700 10px var(--f-label);border:2px solid var(--forest-l);border-radius:6px;background:var(--boxbg);padding:5px 4px;min-height:34px}
.blocos-grid{width:100%;max-width:420px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));grid-template-rows:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:5px;aspect-ratio:1;background:rgba(0,0,0,.12);padding:6px;border-radius:8px;box-sizing:border-box}
.bloco{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));grid-template-rows:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:2px;background:#6b6248;border-radius:4px;padding:2px;min-width:0;min-height:0}
.lot{background:#d8cfa5;border-radius:2px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:1px 2px;gap:1px;color:var(--ink);overflow:hidden;position:relative;min-width:0;min-height:0;transition:filter .12s}
.lot:hover{filter:brightness(1.1)}
.lot.filled{color:#fff;text-shadow:1px 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.lot .lot-emoji{font-size:13px;line-height:1}
.lot .lot-name{font:700 6.5px var(--f-label);line-height:1.05;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;max-width:100%}
.lot .lot-lvl{position:absolute;top:0;right:1px;font-size:6.5px;opacity:.85;line-height:1}
.lot.lot-locked{background:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,#8a8378,#8a8378 4px,#7a7368 4px,#7a7368 8px);cursor:default;color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);font-size:11px}
.bloco.bloco-travado{opacity:.9}
.mapa-tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;max-width:560px;margin:0 auto 12px}
.mapa-tab-btn{font:800 11px var(--f-label);background:var(--boxbg);color:var(--forest);border:2px solid var(--forest-l);border-radius:14px;padding:6px 12px;cursor:pointer}
.mapa-tab-btn.active{background:var(--forest-l-txt);color:#fff;border-color:var(--forest-dd);text-shadow:1px 1px 0 var(--forest-dd)}
.mapa-tab-add{font:800 11px var(--f-label);background:var(--rust-l-txt);color:#fff;border:2px solid var(--rust);border-radius:14px;padding:6px 12px;cursor:pointer}
.mapa-tab-del{font:800 11px var(--f-label);background:transparent;color:var(--rust);border:2px solid var(--rust);border-radius:14px;padding:6px 10px;cursor:pointer}
.mapa-hint-lock{max-width:100%;text-align:center;font-size:11.5px;font-style:italic;color:#6b6248;margin-top:12px}
.infra-row{display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:18px;padding-top:14px;border-top:2px dashed var(--line)}
.mapa-stats{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:16px}
.mapa-alert{max-width:560px;margin:0 auto 12px;text-align:center;font:800 12.5px var(--f-label);color:var(--rust);background:rgba(156,63,40,.12);border:2px solid var(--rust);border-radius:8px;padding:8px}
@media(max-width:420px){.blocos-grid{max-width:100%}.mapa-wrap{padding:14px 8px}}
.picker-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;max-height:340px;overflow-y:auto;margin-top:10px}
.picker-item{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--boxbg);border:2px solid var(--forest-l);border-radius:8px;padding:9px 12px;cursor:pointer}
.picker-item:hover{background:#fffbe9;border-color:var(--forest)}
.picker-name{font:800 13.5px var(--f-label);color:var(--forest-dd)}
.picker-meta{font:700 10.5px var(--f-label);color:var(--forest)}

/* TABELAS */
.tbl-title{font-family:var(--f-title);font-size:16px;color:var(--forest-dd);margin:26px 0 8px;letter-spacing:.5px;text-shadow:1px 1px 0 var(--cream)}
/* Tabelas & Mecânicas: cada tabela vive dentro de um <details> nativo — acessível
   por padrão (foco, Enter/Espaço, leitores de tela anunciam aberto/fechado sem
   ARIA extra), não depende de JS para funcionar, e o conteúdo fechado continua
   no DOM (pesquisável por Ctrl/Cmd+F, e a busca do topo do módulo reabre a
   seção automaticamente ao encontrar um resultado — ver runSearchFilter). */
.tbl-details{margin-bottom:4px}
.tbl-details>summary.tbl-title{cursor:pointer;list-style:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;user-select:none;min-height:var(--tap);-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
.tbl-details>summary.tbl-title::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.tbl-details>summary.tbl-title::before{content:'▸';display:inline-block;font-size:13px;color:var(--forest);transition:transform .15s}
.tbl-details[open]>summary.tbl-title::before{transform:rotate(90deg)}
.tbl-details>summary.tbl-title:hover{color:var(--forest-l-txt)}
.tbl-details>summary.tbl-title:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:4px}
.tbl-wrap{margin:0 0 22px;overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;
  content-visibility:auto;contain-intrinsic-size:auto 400px} /* tabelas de referência longas dentro de <details> abertos — mesmo raciocínio do .history-item acima */
.tbl{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13.5px;background:rgba(250,244,224,.7);box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(60,40,0,.18)}
.tbl th{background:linear-gradient(#3d5a26,#242f10);color:#fff;font:800 12px var(--f-label);text-align:left;padding:8px 10px;letter-spacing:.4px;border:1px solid var(--forest-dd);position:sticky;top:0}
.tbl td{padding:7px 10px;color:var(--forest-dd);border:1px solid rgba(76,90,32,.3);vertical-align:top;font-weight:600}
.tbl tbody tr:nth-child(odd) td{background:rgba(190,170,110,.22)}
.tbl tbody tr:nth-child(even) td{background:rgba(250,244,220,.6)}
.tbl tr.row-active td{background:rgba(201,162,39,.35);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--gold)}
.tbl .num{text-align:center;font-weight:800}
.tbl-note{font-size:13px;font-style:italic;color:#524a34;margin:8px 2px 18px}
.tbl-cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:26px}
@media(max-width:900px){.tbl-cols{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.etapa-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;margin-bottom:20px}
@media(max-width:900px){.etapa-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.etapa-block{background:rgba(250,244,224,.7);border:1px solid rgba(76,90,32,.35);border-radius:8px;padding:11px 14px;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(60,40,0,.12)}
.etapa-title{font:800 13px var(--f-label);color:var(--forest-dd);margin-bottom:6px;letter-spacing:.3px}
ul.etapa-list{list-style:none}
ul.etapa-list li{font-size:13px;color:var(--forest-dd);padding:3px 0;border-bottom:1px dotted rgba(76,90,32,.25)}
ul.etapa-list li:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.mec-block{background:rgba(250,244,224,.7);border:1px solid rgba(76,90,32,.35);border-radius:8px;padding:14px 18px;margin-bottom:18px;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(60,40,0,.12);
  content-visibility:auto;contain-intrinsic-size:auto 200px}
.mec-title{font-family:var(--f-title);font-size:15px;color:var(--forest-dd);margin-bottom:8px;letter-spacing:.4px}
.mec-block p{font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:8px;text-align:justify;color:var(--forest-dd)}
.mec-block p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.mec-box{background:rgba(138,154,75,.28);border:1.5px solid var(--forest);border-radius:6px;padding:9px 12px;
  font:800 13px var(--f-label);color:var(--forest-dd);text-align:center;margin:10px 0}

/* ===== MODAIS / TOAST ===== */
.overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(38,28,10,.58);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:50;
  padding:16px;padding:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-top)) max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right)) max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left))}
.overlay.open{display:flex}
#confirmOverlay{z-index:60} /* fica sempre acima de outros overlays (ex.: confirmar exclusão dentro de "Carregar salvos") */
.modal{
  width:min(660px,94vw);
  max-height:min(88vh,720px);max-height:min(88dvh,720px);
  overflow-y:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;
  background:var(--cream);border:3px solid var(--forest-dd);border-radius:14px;
  padding:20px 22px 4px;box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
}
.modal h3{font-family:var(--f-title);color:var(--forest-dd);font-size:17px;margin:14px 0 16px;text-align:center;letter-spacing:.5px}
.modal .banner{flex:0 0 auto}
.modal form{display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex:1;min-height:0}
.form-field{margin-bottom:13px}
.form-field label{display:block;margin-bottom:5px}
.form-field input,.form-field select,.form-field textarea{width:100%;background:var(--boxbg);border:2px solid var(--forest-l);border-radius:7px;padding:11px 12px;font:600 15px var(--f-body);color:var(--ink);outline:none;min-height:var(--tap)}
.form-field textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:88px}
.form-field input:disabled{opacity:.6;background:var(--cream)}
.form-field select{-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;background-image:linear-gradient(45deg,transparent 50%,var(--forest) 50%),linear-gradient(135deg,var(--forest) 50%,transparent 50%);background-position:calc(100% - 18px) center,calc(100% - 12px) center;background-size:6px 6px,6px 6px;background-repeat:no-repeat}
.modal-actions{
  display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:flex-end;flex-wrap:wrap;
  position:sticky;bottom:0;background:var(--cream);
  margin:16px -22px 0;padding:14px 22px 16px;
  box-shadow:0 -8px 10px -6px rgba(38,28,10,.18);
}
.modal-actions button{font:800 13px var(--f-label);cursor:pointer;border-radius:8px;padding:11px 20px;letter-spacing:.5px;min-height:var(--tap)}
.btn-save{background:linear-gradient(#7f9040,#4c5b23);border:2px solid var(--forest-dd);color:#fff;text-shadow:1px 1px 0 var(--forest-dd)}
.btn-cancel{background:transparent;border:2px solid var(--forest-dd);color:var(--forest-dd)}
.btn-clear{background:linear-gradient(#c96a52,#8a3220);border:2px solid #6f2417;color:#fff;text-shadow:1px 1px 0 #6f2417;margin-right:auto}
#infoBody{white-space:pre-line}
#toast{position:fixed;bottom:calc(22px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(80px);z-index:60;transition:.3s;
  background:linear-gradient(#7f9040,#4c5b23);color:#fff;font:800 13px var(--f-label);letter-spacing:.5px;border:2px solid var(--forest-dd);
  border-radius:20px;padding:9px 22px;text-shadow:1px 1px 0 var(--forest-dd);opacity:0;max-width:92vw;text-align:center;
  pointer-events:none /* nunca teve ação de clique; evita capturar toques mesmo invisível, agora que a barra de abas inferior ocupa a mesma região em celular */}
#toast.show{transform:translateX(-50%);opacity:1}

@media print{#sidebar,.honey,.btn-add,.card-actions,#toast,.mini-act,#topbar-space,.search-input,#btnResetTurn{display:none!important}body{background:#fff}}

/* ===== RESPONSIVO ===== */
@media(max-width:1080px){
  #sidebar{width:186px;flex:0 0 186px}
  #main{padding:22px 20px 56px}
}
@media(max-width:820px){
  /* A barra lateral (#sidebar) deixa de ser a navegação em celular — é
     substituída pela barra de abas inferior (#bottomNav) + folha "Mais",
     que ficam na zona de alcance do polegar. Nada do conteúdo do #sidebar
     é perdido: os botões de Exportar/Importar/Restaurar e o aviso de
     salvamento automático (.side-footer) são realocados via JS para dentro
     da folha "Mais" enquanto a tela estiver nesta faixa (ver script
     `posicionarSideFooter`), e voltam ao lugar original assim que a tela
     alcança novamente 821px+. Em ≥821px esta regra não se aplica e o
     #sidebar permanece exatamente como sempre foi. */
  #app{flex-direction:column}
  #sidebar{display:none}
  #main{padding:18px 14px calc(50px + var(--bottomnav-h) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
  #toast{bottom:calc(var(--bottomnav-h) + 14px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
  #bottomNav{display:flex}
  .anchor-chip-bar{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;scrollbar-width:none;padding:2px 2px 10px;margin-top:-6px}
  .anchor-chip-bar::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
}
@media(max-width:760px){
  /* Perícias: substitui a grade de 11 colunas (que só era usável com rolagem
     horizontal — .sk-min tinha min-width:1090px) por uma lista de cartões,
     um por perícia, com exatamente os mesmos campos. Ver skillCardHTML() e
     renderSkillsRows() no script; updateAllSkills() não precisou mudar. */
  .sk-head{display:none}
  .sk-wrap{overflow-x:visible;padding-bottom:0}
  .sk-min{min-width:0}
  #skillsRows{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
  .sk-card{background:var(--boxbg);border:2px solid var(--forest-l);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(60,40,0,.15)}
  .sk-card-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:8px}
  .sk-card-top .sk-name{flex:1;min-width:0;font:800 15px var(--f-label);color:var(--forest-dd)}
  .sk-card-top .sk-total{width:54px;height:42px;font-size:17px;flex:0 0 auto}
  .sk-card-ranks{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-bottom:8px;padding-bottom:8px;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line)}
  .sk-card-ranks .ranks{gap:8px}
  .sk-card-ranks .rank{width:38px;height:40px;font-size:14px}
  .sk-card-ranks .sk-prof{width:46px;height:40px;font-size:14px;flex:0 0 auto}
  .sk-card-nums{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:6px}
  .sk-numlabel{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:3px;min-width:0}
  .sk-numlabel span:first-child{font:700 8px var(--f-label);color:var(--forest);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px;white-space:nowrap}
  .sk-numlabel .box-input{width:100%;height:38px;font-size:13px;padding:0}
}
@media(max-width:700px){
  body{font-size:15.5px}
  #main{padding:14px 10px 44px}
  .sheet{padding:16px 12px;border-radius:10px}
  .sheet-top{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:12px}
  .kingdom-name{min-width:0}
  .kingdom-name .big{font-size:18px;white-space:normal}
  .top-boxes{justify-content:flex-start}
  .stats-row{gap:6px}
  .stat{min-width:44%}
  .mat-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(72px,1fr))}
  .mat-grid.six{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
  .work-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .field{gap:6px}
  .cd-break{font-size:9.5px}
  .att-row .box-input.sm{width:50px;height:44px}
  .ruin-head{grid-template-columns:1fr 46px 46px 46px}
  .ruin-head .h-res{display:none}
  .ruin-row{grid-template-columns:1fr 46px 46px 46px}
  
  .ruin-row input,.ru-disp{width:100%;height:44px;font-size:14px}
  .ru-reswrap{grid-column:1/-1;justify-content:flex-start;min-width:0;margin-top:4px}
  .ru-reslabel{display:inline}
  .rk-box{width:20px;height:20px}
  .card-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .modal{border-radius:12px;padding:16px 16px 4px}
  .modal-actions{margin:14px -16px 0;padding:12px 16px 14px}

  /* Alvos de toque — bumps mobile-only; nada disso afeta telas ≥701px.
     Preferido a truques de área de toque invisível onde os controles ficam
     lado a lado (rk-box, mini-act, ed-del não competem por espaço tão
     apertado quanto o `.rank` da tabela de Perícias, por isso o aumento é
     visual e direto em vez de uma zona de toque sobreposta ao vizinho). */
  .rk-box{width:26px;height:26px;margin-left:6px}
  .mini-act{gap:8px}
  .mini-act button{min-width:40px;min-height:40px;font-size:17px}
  .ed-del{min-width:44px;min-height:44px;font-size:19px}
}
@media(max-width:380px){
  .modal-actions{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}
  .modal-actions button{width:100%}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<svg class="honey" aria-hidden="true"><defs>
<pattern id="hexPat" width="56" height="100" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
<path d="M28 66L0 50L0 16L28 0L56 16L56 50L28 66L28 100" fill="none" stroke="#d3af3f" stroke-width="3" opacity=".5"/>
</pattern></defs><rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="url(#hexPat)"/></svg>
<div id="app">
<aside id="sidebar" aria-label="Navegação principal">
<div class="side-title">❦ Gerenciador KM</div>
<div role="tablist" aria-label="Módulos" style="display:contents">
<button class="nav-btn active" id="navtab-reino" data-mod="reino" role="tab" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="mod-reino"><span class="ico">📜</span><span class="lbl">Ficha do Reino</span></button>
<button class="nav-btn" id="navtab-pericias" data-mod="pericias" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="mod-pericias"><span class="ico">🎓</span><span class="lbl">Perícias &amp; Talentos</span></button>
<button class="nav-btn" id="navtab-npcs" data-mod="npcs" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="mod-npcs"><span class="ico">👤</span><span class="lbl">PCs, NPCs e Facções</span></button>
<button class="nav-btn" id="navtab-locais" data-mod="locais" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="mod-locais"><span class="ico">🏰</span><span class="lbl">Fichas de Locais</span></button>
<button class="nav-btn" id="navtab-eventos" data-mod="eventos" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="mod-eventos"><span class="ico">🎲</span><span class="lbl">Eventos</span></button>
<button class="nav-btn" id="navtab-hexcrawl" data-mod="hexcrawl" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="mod-hexcrawl"><span class="ico">🗺️</span><span class="lbl">Hexcrawl</span></button>
<button class="nav-btn" id="navtab-turno" data-mod="turno" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="mod-turno"><span class="ico">⏳</span><span class="lbl">Turno &amp; Histórico</span></button>
<button class="nav-btn" id="navtab-notas" data-mod="notas" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="mod-notas"><span class="ico">✒️</span><span class="lbl">Notas &amp; Crônicas</span></button>
<button class="nav-btn" id="navtab-estruturas" data-mod="estruturas" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="mod-estruturas"><span class="ico">📖</span><span class="lbl">Catálogo de Estruturas</span></button>
<button class="nav-btn" id="navtab-tabelas" data-mod="tabelas" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="mod-tabelas"><span class="ico">📚</span><span class="lbl">Tabelas &amp; Mecânicas</span></button>
</div>
<div class="side-footer" id="sideFooter">
<button type="button" id="btnExport">⬇ Exportar backup</button>
<button type="button" id="btnImport">⬆ Importar backup</button>
<button type="button" id="btnSaveSlot">💾 Salvar no arquivo</button>
<button type="button" id="btnLoadSlot">🗂 Carregar salvos</button>
<button type="button" id="btnReset">⚠ Restaurar padrão</button>
<div class="side-note">SALVAMENTO AUTOMÁTICO ATIVO</div>
<div class="side-note" id="lastBackupNote" style="display:none"></div>
<input type="file" id="importFile" accept=".json" hidden>
</div>
</aside>
<main id="main">

<section id="mod-reino" class="module active" role="tabpanel" aria-label="Ficha do Reino" tabindex="0"><div class="sheet">
<div class="sheet-top">
<div class="kingdom-name"><span class="big">Nome do Reino</span><input class="line-input" data-k="reino.nome" aria-label="Nome do Reino"></div>
<div class="top-boxes">
<div class="tbox"><div class="tiny">MAX <input class="tiny-input" data-k="reino.nivelMax" aria-label="Nível Máximo do Reino"></div>
<input class="box-input tbox-main" data-k="reino.nivel" aria-label="Nível do Reino" inputmode="numeric"><div class="nivel-tag">NÍVEL</div></div>
<div class="tbox"><label>FAMA <input class="line-input" data-k="reino.fama" inputmode="numeric"></label>
<label>INFÂMIA <input class="line-input" data-k="reino.infamia" inputmode="numeric"></label></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="anchor-chip-bar" aria-label="Ir para seção da ficha">
<a class="anchor-chip" href="#sec-atributos">Atributos</a>
<a class="anchor-chip" href="#sec-ruina">Ruína</a>
<a class="anchor-chip" href="#sec-materiais">Materiais</a>
<a class="anchor-chip" href="#sec-trabalho">Trabalho</a>
<a class="anchor-chip" href="#sec-acordos">Acordos</a>
<a class="anchor-chip" href="#sec-lideres">Líderes</a>
<a class="anchor-chip" href="#sec-bau">Baú do Grupo</a>
</div>
<div class="sheet-cols">
<div>
<details class="section-details" id="sec-atributos" open>
<summary class="banner">Valores de Atributo <span class="disc-ico" aria-hidden="true">▾</span></summary>
<div class="att-head"><span>MODIFICADOR</span><span style="flex:1"></span></div>
<div class="att-row"><input class="box-input sm" data-k="reino.att.cultura.mod" aria-label="Modificador de Cultura"><div class="att-label">Cultura</div></div>
<div class="att-row"><input class="box-input sm" data-k="reino.att.economia.mod" aria-label="Modificador de Economia"><div class="att-label">Economia</div></div>
<div class="att-row"><input class="box-input sm" data-k="reino.att.lealdade.mod" aria-label="Modificador de Lealdade"><div class="att-label">Lealdade</div></div>
<div class="att-row"><input class="box-input sm" data-k="reino.att.estabilidade.mod" aria-label="Modificador de Estabilidade"><div class="att-label">Estabilidade</div></div>
<hr class="rule">
<div class="banner small">CD de Controle</div>
<div class="cd-row"><div class="box-input cd-total" id="cdTotal">—</div></div>
<div class="cd-break" id="cdBreakdown"></div>
</details>
<hr class="rule">
<div id="sec-ruina">
<div class="banner clickable" id="ruinaInfoBtn" title="Ver regra de Ruína, Desordem e Resistência a Ruína">Ruína ℹ️</div>
<div class="ruin-head"><span>TIPO</span><span>VALOR</span><span>PEN.</span><span>LIMIAR</span><span class="h-res">RES. RUÍNA</span></div>
<div class="ruin-row"><div class="att-label">Corrupção</div><input class="box-input" data-k="reino.ruina.corrupcao.valor" inputmode="numeric" title="Pontos de Ruína"><input class="box-input" data-k="reino.ruina.corrupcao.pen" disabled title="Calculado automaticamente (Valor ÷ Limiar)"><span class="box-input ru-disp" id="ruLim-corrupcao">10</span><span class="ru-reswrap" id="ruRes-corrupcao"></span></div>
<div class="ruin-row"><div class="att-label">Crime</div><input class="box-input" data-k="reino.ruina.crime.valor" inputmode="numeric" title="Pontos de Ruína"><input class="box-input" data-k="reino.ruina.crime.pen" disabled title="Calculado automaticamente (Valor ÷ Limiar)"><span class="box-input ru-disp" id="ruLim-crime">10</span><span class="ru-reswrap" id="ruRes-crime"></span></div>
<div class="ruin-row"><div class="att-label">Decadência</div><input class="box-input" data-k="reino.ruina.decadencia.valor" inputmode="numeric" title="Pontos de Ruína"><input class="box-input" data-k="reino.ruina.decadencia.pen" disabled title="Calculado automaticamente (Valor ÷ Limiar)"><span class="box-input ru-disp" id="ruLim-decadencia">10</span><span class="ru-reswrap" id="ruRes-decadencia"></span></div>
<div class="ruin-row"><div class="att-label">Conflito</div><input class="box-input" data-k="reino.ruina.conflito.valor" inputmode="numeric" title="Pontos de Ruína"><input class="box-input" data-k="reino.ruina.conflito.pen" disabled title="Calculado automaticamente (Valor ÷ Limiar)"><span class="box-input ru-disp" id="ruLim-conflito">10</span><span class="ru-reswrap" id="ruRes-conflito"></span></div>
<div class="stat-note" id="resistNote"></div>
</div>
<hr class="rule">
<details class="section-details" id="sec-materiais" open>
<summary class="banner">Materiais <span class="disc-ico" aria-hidden="true">▾</span></summary>
<div class="mat-grid">
<div class="mat"><span class="label-sc">Comida</span><input class="box-input" data-k="reino.materiais.comida.val" aria-label="Comida — material armazenado"><span class="mat-sub">Material Armazenado</span><span class="mat-max">Armazenamento de Material, Qtd. Max: <b class="matMaxVal">—</b></span></div>
<div class="mat"><span class="label-sc">Lenha</span><input class="box-input" data-k="reino.materiais.lenha.val" aria-label="Lenha — material armazenado"><span class="mat-sub">Material Armazenado</span><span class="mat-max">Armazenamento de Material, Qtd. Max: <b class="matMaxVal">—</b></span></div>
<div class="mat"><span class="label-sc">Luxos</span><input class="box-input" data-k="reino.materiais.luxos.val" aria-label="Luxos — material armazenado"><span class="mat-sub">Material Armazenado</span><span class="mat-max">Armazenamento de Material, Qtd. Max: <b class="matMaxVal">—</b></span></div>
<div class="mat"><span class="label-sc">Minério</span><input class="box-input" data-k="reino.materiais.minerio.val" aria-label="Minério — material armazenado"><span class="mat-sub">Material Armazenado</span><span class="mat-max">Armazenamento de Material, Qtd. Max: <b class="matMaxVal">—</b></span></div>
<div class="mat"><span class="label-sc">Pedra</span><input class="box-input" data-k="reino.materiais.pedra.val" aria-label="Pedra — material armazenado"><span class="mat-sub">Material Armazenado</span><span class="mat-max">Armazenamento de Material, Qtd. Max: <b class="matMaxVal">—</b></span></div>
</div>
</details>
<details class="section-details" id="sec-trabalho" open style="margin-top:18px">
<summary class="banner small">Locais de Trabalho <span class="disc-ico" aria-hidden="true">▾</span></summary>
<div class="work-grid">
<div class="mat"><span class="label-sc link compact" id="terrInfoBtn" title="Clique para ver a regra">Terras Agrícolas</span><input class="box-input" data-k="reino.locaisTrab.terras" aria-label="Terras Agrícolas — locais de trabalho"></div>
<div class="mat"><span class="label-sc compact">Madeira</span><input class="box-input" data-k="reino.locaisTrab.madeira" aria-label="Madeira — locais de trabalho"></div>
<div class="mat"><span class="label-sc compact">Minas</span><input class="box-input" data-k="reino.locaisTrab.minas" aria-label="Minas — locais de trabalho"></div>
<div class="mat"><span class="label-sc compact">Pedreiras</span><input class="box-input" data-k="reino.locaisTrab.pedreiras" aria-label="Pedreiras — locais de trabalho"></div>
</div>
<p class="work-note">Colete materiais para cada Local de Trabalho estabelecido no reino. Você recebe 1 Material para cada Local de Trabalho ou o dobro, se o Local de Trabalho estiver em um hexágono de Recurso. Qualquer Material coletado além da capacidade de armazenamento (página 532) é perdido.</p>
</details>
<div class="work-block" id="sec-acordos" style="margin-top:18px">
<div class="banner small clickable" id="acordosInfoBtn" title="Clique para ver a regra da atividade">Acordos Comerciais <span id="acordosCount">(0)</span> ℹ️</div>
<div id="acordosListWrap" style="margin-top:10px"></div>
<button type="button" class="btn-add small" id="addAcordoBtn" style="margin-top:8px">+ Adicionar Acordo</button>
</div>
</div>
<div>
<div class="field"><span class="label-sc">Licença</span><input class="line-input" data-k="reino.licenca" aria-label="Licença"></div>
<div class="field"><span class="label-sc">R. Central</span><input class="line-input" data-k="reino.rCentral" aria-label="R. Central"></div>
<div class="field"><span class="label-sc">Local Mapa</span><input class="line-input" data-k="reino.localMapa" placeholder="Ex: Hexágono da Capital"></div>
<div class="field"><span class="label-sc">Governo</span><input class="line-input" data-k="reino.governo" aria-label="Governo"></div>
<div class="field"><span class="label-sc">Capital</span><input class="line-input" data-k="reino.capital" aria-label="Capital"></div>
<div class="field"><span class="label-sc">XP</span><input class="line-input" data-k="reino.xp" aria-label="XP" inputmode="numeric"></div>
<div class="field"><span class="label-sc">D. de Recurso</span><input class="line-input" id="dRecursoBox" disabled title="Conforme tabela Tamanho do Reino (pelo campo Tam.)"></div>
<div class="stats-row">
<div class="stat"><span class="label-sc">Tam.</span><input class="box-input" data-k="reino.tam" title="Vinculado ao nível pela tabela Tipos de Assentamento (editável)"></div>
<div class="stat"><span class="label-sc">Desordem</span><input class="box-input" data-k="reino.unrest" aria-label="Desordem"></div>
<div class="stat"><span class="label-sc">Pen. Conflito</span><input class="box-input" data-k="reino.penConflito" aria-label="Penalidade de Conflito"></div>
<div class="stat"><span class="label-sc">Consumo</span><input class="box-input" id="consumoBox" disabled title="Consumo = Tipos de Assentamento (nível) − Terras Agrícolas"></div>
</div>
<div class="stat-note" id="desordemNote"></div>
<div class="stat-note">Tam. é vinculado ao Nível pela tabela Tipos de Assentamento; Consumo = Tipos de Assentamento − Terras Agrícolas; CD de Controle, D. de Recurso e o Armazenamento de Material são calculados pelas tabelas Evolução do Reino e Tamanho do Reino.</div>
<div class="banner" id="sec-lideres">Líderes</div>
<div class="leader-note">Clique no nome para escolher ou cadastrar um PC/NPC</div>
<div id="leaders"></div>
<hr class="rule">
<details class="section-details" id="sec-bau" open style="margin-top:18px">
<summary class="banner">Baú do Grupo <span class="disc-ico" aria-hidden="true">▾</span></summary>
<div class="mat-grid">
<div class="mat"><span class="label-sc">Ouro</span><input class="box-input" data-k="bau.ouro" aria-label="Ouro — Baú do Grupo" inputmode="numeric"></div>
<div class="mat"><span class="label-sc">Prata</span><input class="box-input" data-k="bau.prata" aria-label="Prata — Baú do Grupo" inputmode="numeric"></div>
<div class="mat"><span class="label-sc">Cobre</span><input class="box-input" data-k="bau.cobre" aria-label="Cobre — Baú do Grupo" inputmode="numeric"></div>
<div class="mat"><span class="label-sc">Objetos de Arte em PO</span><input class="box-input" data-k="bau.pecasOuro" aria-label="Objetos de Arte em PO — Baú do Grupo" inputmode="numeric"></div>
<div class="mat"><span class="label-sc">Total em PO</span><span class="box-input" id="bauTotalPO" style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center" title="Cobre + Prata + Ouro + Objetos de Arte em PO, convertidos em Peças de Ouro (10 Cobre = 1 Prata · 10 Prata = 1 Ouro · 1 Objeto de Arte = 1 PO)">0</span><span class="mat-sub">Convertido</span></div>
</div>
<p class="work-note" style="margin-top:8px">Conversão automática: 10 Cobre = 1 Prata · 10 Prata = 1 Ouro · 1 Objeto de Arte em PO = 1 Peça de Ouro. Ouro e Objetos de Arte em PO somam-se diretamente no total (mesma unidade). Útil para saber quanto o grupo tem para doar em Utilizar Tesouro Nacional.</p>
<div class="banner small" style="margin-top:16px">Itens para Venda</div>
<div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:8px"><button type="button" class="btn-add small" data-add="itensVenda">+ Adicionar Item</button></div>
<div class="card-grid" id="grid-itensVenda" style="margin-top:10px"></div>
</details>
</div>
</div>
</div></section>

<section id="mod-turno" class="module" role="tabpanel" aria-label="Turno &amp; Histórico" tabindex="0">

              <ul class="phase-opts">
                <li class="atividade-nota-item" data-nota-key="coletar-impostos" tabindex="0" role="button">Coletar Impostos (pág. 530)</li>

                  <li class="atividade-nota-item" data-nota-key="reparar-reputacao" tabindex="0" role="button">Reparar Reputação (pág. 521)</li>
                  <li class="atividade-nota-item" data-nota-key="reprimir-desordem" tabindex="0" role="button">Reprimir Desordem (pág. 521)</li>

              <ul class="phase-opts">

              <summary class="phase-summary">Fase 4: Eventos <span class="phase-progress">0/2</span></summary>

            Calculado por: <strong>Nível do Reino + 4</strong>. Tipo de dado muda conforme o <strong>Tamanho</strong>.
          </p>
          <div style="display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 15px; flex-wrap: wrap;">
            <label style="flex:1; min-width: 120px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: bold; color: var(--forest-dd);">
              Bônus de Dados (+):<br>
              <input type="number" id="rpBonusDice" value="0" min="0" style="width:100%; margin-top:5px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px; border: 2px solid var(--forest-l); background: var(--boxbg);">
            </label>
            <button class="btn-add" id="btnRollRP" style="flex:2; min-width: 150px; margin-top: 18px;">Rolar Recursos</button>
          </div>
          <div id="rpRollResult" style="font-size: 1.2em; font-weight: bold; color: var(--rust); background: var(--parchment); padding: 10px; border-radius: 4px; text-align: center; border: 1px dashed var(--rust-l);">
            Aguardando rolagem...
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <hr class="rule">
      
      <div class="form-field">
        <label class="label-sc">Anotações do Turno (Crônicas, Obras, Ocorrências)</label>

      </div>
    
      <div style="text-align:right">
        <button type="button" class="btn-add" id="btnFinishTurn">✔ Finalizar Turno &amp; Guardar Histórico</button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="wizard-title">Histórico de Turnos</div>
    <div id="turnHistoryList"></div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="mod-pericias" class="module" role="tabpanel" aria-label="Perícias &amp; Talentos" tabindex="0"><div class="sheet">

<div class="sk-head"><span></span><span></span><span></span><span>ATRIBUTO</span><span>PROF</span>
<span style="letter-spacing:6px" aria-hidden="true">T E M L</span><span>ESTADO</span><span>CIRC.</span><span>ITEM</span><span>OUTROS</span><span>PENALIDADE</span></div>
<div id="skillsRows"></div>
</div></div>
<div class="stat-note" id="skBreakdown" style="margin-top:6px"></div>

Total = Mod. do Atributo + PROF + Estado (+ penalidade de Desordem) + Circ. + Item + Outros (+ bônus de PCs/NPCs/Facções) + Penalidade de Ruína do atributo.</p>

<div><div class="banner">Talentos</div><div style="text-align:right;margin:6px 0"><button type="button" class="btn-add small" id="addTal">+ Adicionar</button></div><div id="talList"></div></div>
<div><div class="banner">Habilidades</div><div style="text-align:right;margin:6px 0"><button type="button" class="btn-add small" id="addHab">+ Adicionar</button></div><div id="habList"></div></div>
</div>
</div></section>

<section id="mod-locais" class="module" role="tabpanel" aria-label="Fichas de Locais" tabindex="0">
<div id="locaisList">
<div class="mod-head">
  <div class="banner big">Fichas de Locais</div>
  <input type="text" class="search-input m0" data-target="grid-locais" placeholder="🔍 Buscar local...">
  <button type="button" class="btn-add btn-viewswitch" data-viewswitch="locais">🗂️ Visualização: Cartões</button>
  <button type="button" class="btn-add" id="addLocal">+ Adicionar</button>
</div>
<div class="card-grid" id="grid-locais"></div>
<div class="stack-nav" id="stacknav-locais" hidden>
  <button type="button" class="btn-mini" data-stacknav="prev" data-key="locais">← Anterior</button>
  <span class="stack-counter">0 / 0</span>
  <button type="button" class="btn-mini" data-stacknav="next" data-key="locais">Próximo →</button>
</div>
</div>
<div id="localFicha" hidden><div style="max-width:1150px;margin:0 auto">
<div class="mod-head"><button type="button" class="btn-add" id="backLocais">← Voltar à lista</button></div>
<div class="sheet">
  <div class="sheet-top" style="border-bottom:2px solid rgba(138,154,75,.4); padding-bottom:16px; margin-bottom:16px;">
    <div class="kingdom-name">
      <span class="big" style="font-size:20px">Nome do Local</span>
      <input class="line-input" data-lk="nome" placeholder="Ex: Fortaleza Intrépida">
    </div>
    <div class="top-boxes">
      <div class="tbox" style="padding:6px 12px; min-width:0; background:transparent; border:none; display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px 12px;">

Você pode guardar quantos salvamentos quiser e voltar a eles depois em "Carregar salvos".</p>

<script>
'use strict';
const KEY='kingmaker_gerenciador_v4';
const rid=()=>Date.now().toString(36)+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7);

// Utilitário genérico de debounce — usado para evitar reconstruir listas/tabelas
// inteiras (via innerHTML) a cada tecla digitada em campos de texto longos.
function debounce(fn,wait){let t;return function(...args){clearTimeout(t);t=setTimeout(()=>fn.apply(this,args),wait)}}
window.addEventListener('error',e=>{const t=$('toast');if(t){t.textContent='⚠ Erro: '+e.message;t.classList.add('show');setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('show'),3000)}});
const memStore={};
function storeGet(){try{return window.localStorage.getItem(KEY)}catch(e){return memStore[KEY]??null}}
function storeSet(v){try{window.localStorage.setItem(KEY,v)}catch(e){memStore[KEY]=v}}
